decision_table.name: Determine_WY_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Wyoming annual report. Note: Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - no tax return required.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in Wyoming (incorporated or registered to do business)

rule.policy:
Wyoming Domestic Corporation - Annual Report Required
Wyoming has NO corporate income tax.
Filing Requirements: - Annual Report: Required (due on first day of anniversary month) - Annual Report Fee: $60 (domestic corporation) - Tax Return: NOT REQUIRED (no corporate income tax)
Wyoming does not tax: - Corporate net income - Gross receipts - Franchise/capital stock
Wyoming only requires: - Annual report filing with Secretary of State - Business licenses (county/municipality level) - Registered agent in Wyoming
Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630 - Annual Report Reference: Wyoming Secretary of State - Annual Report Filing Reference: No Wyoming corporate income tax statutes exist

Wyoming Foreign Corporation - Annual Report Required
Wyoming has NO corporate income tax.
Filing Requirements: - Annual Report: Required (due on first day of anniversary month) - Annual Report Fee: $120 (foreign corporation registered in Wyoming) - Tax Return: NOT REQUIRED (no corporate income tax)
Foreign corporation means: - Incorporated outside Wyoming - Registered to do business in Wyoming (Certificate of Authority) - Must maintain registered agent in Wyoming
Wyoming does not tax: - Corporate net income - Gross receipts - Franchise/capital stock
Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1630 - Annual Report Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1520 - Certificate of Authority Reference: Wyoming Secretary of State - Foreign Corporation Registration

No Wyoming presence - no filing requirement.
Corporation is not: - Incorporated in Wyoming (not domestic) - Registered to do business in Wyoming (not foreign authorized)
Therefore: - No annual report filing required - No annual report fee - No tax liability (Wyoming has no corporate income tax anyway)
Any estimated payments would be refunded.
Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1501 - Authority to Transact Business Required

decision_table.name: Calculate_WY_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Wyoming has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

rule.policy:
Wyoming has NO corporate income tax.
Wyoming does NOT tax: - Corporate net income (no income tax) - Gross receipts (no Commerce Tax like Nevada) - Franchise or capital stock (no franchise tax like Delaware) - Business property (no state-level property tax on business assets)
Wyoming ONLY requires: - Annual report filing fee ($60 domestic, $120 foreign) - Business licenses (county/municipal level, varies by location) - Sales tax compliance (4% state sales tax, plus local options)
Why Wyoming has no corporate income tax: Wyoming's revenue comes primarily from mineral severance taxes (oil, gas, coal) and federal mineral royalties. This allows Wyoming to avoid corporate income tax while maintaining one of the most business-friendly environments in the nation.
This decision table confirms zero income tax for framework consistency.
Reference: Wyoming Constitution Article 15, Section 3 - Taxation Reference: Wyoming Statutes Title 39 - Revenue and Taxation (no corporate income tax chapter) Reference: Wyoming does not have corporate income tax statutes

No Wyoming presence - no tax liability.
Wyoming has no corporate income tax regardless of nexus status.

decision_table.name: Calculate_WY_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Wyoming state tax liability. Wyoming has NO corporate income tax - always returns $0 tax.

condition.name: has_presence
condition.comment: Has presence in Wyoming (incorporated or registered)

rule.policy:
Wyoming State Tax Calculation: $0
IMPORTANT: Wyoming has NO corporate income tax.
Wyoming does NOT impose: - Corporate income tax (0% rate) - Gross receipts tax (unlike Nevada, Washington) - Franchise tax (unlike Delaware, California) - Capital stock tax - Business personal property tax (at state level)
Wyoming ONLY requires: 1. Annual Report Filing Fee: - Domestic corporations: $60 - Foreign corporations: $120 - Due: First day of anniversary month
2. Business Licenses (county/municipal): - Vary by location and industry - Typically $25-$200 annually
3. Sales Tax Compliance: - 4% state sales tax - Local option taxes (up to 2%) - Economic nexus: $100,000 or 200 transactions
Why Wyoming is Business-Friendly: - No corporate income tax - No personal income tax - Strong asset protection laws (LLCs, trusts) - Low regulatory burden - Revenue from mineral extraction (oil, gas, coal) - Federal mineral royalties fund state operations
Any estimated tax payments would be fully refunded since Wyoming has no corporate income tax to apply payments against.
Note: Annual report fees are administrative fees, not taxes, and are paid directly to the Secretary of State (not calculated here).
Reference: Wyoming Statutes Title 39 - Revenue and Taxation Reference: Wyoming Secretary of State - Business Division Reference: Wyoming does not have corporate income tax enabling statutes Reference: Wyoming Economic Analysis Division - Revenue Sources

No Wyoming presence - no tax liability.
Corporation is not incorporated in Wyoming and not registered to do business in Wyoming, therefore: - No annual report filing required - No annual report fee - No tax liability (Wyoming has no corporate income tax anyway)
Any estimated payments would be fully refunded.
Reference: Wyoming Statutes 17-16-1501 - Authority to Transact Business
